name: summarize_inbox
description: Fetch recent Gmail messages and prepare them for AI summarization. Optionally filter by a Gmail search query.

arguments.name: max_results
arguments.description: Maximum number of emails to include (default: 20)

name: analyze_spreadsheet
description: Read a Google Sheet range and prepare the data for AI analysis or visualization.

name: plan_week
description: Fetch upcoming calendar events and prepare a weekly planning summary for AI-assisted scheduling.

arguments.name: days_ahead
arguments.description: Number of days to look ahead (default: 7)

name: search_drive
description: Search Google Drive for files and prepare a structured list for AI review or organisation suggestions.

name: weekly_review
description: Cross-source review of the last N days: mail, changed files and the coming agenda, prepared for a weekly summary.

arguments.name: days_back
arguments.description: How many days to look back (default: 7)

name: inbox_triage
description: Fetch a Gmail slice and prepare it for triage: urgent, waiting, informational, archive candidates.

name: compare_brief
description: Diff two ranges by a key column and prepare a reconciliation report.
